verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability platform, but the pack has no documentation of retention-period settings or deletion of stored telemetry. The closest items are adjacent: 'Drop Logs' filters logs at ingestion to cut costs, and self-hosting gives control of the data plane. Neither is a documented retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
